title: Populate content_browsing.dart barrel with real exports so Rule 2 has a legal import path
why: The barrel file has zero export statements, so there is no compliant way for other code to reach ContentRepository, contentRepositoryProvider, curriculumContentProvider or ContentItemTile — every consumer (core/labels/, core/content/, and every deep import inside this batch's own screens into dashboard/learning/scheduler/tutoring/gamification/tracks) is forced into a deep import because the barrel offers nothing. lib/features/progress/progress.dart shows the intended pattern (documented policy + real `export` lines); content_browsing's barrel (like several other features sampled: gamification, dashboard, onboarding, notifications, profiles, learning) is only a decorative stub.
recommendation: Follow progress.dart's pattern: export ContentRepository, contentRepositoryProvider, curriculumContentProvider, and ContentItemTile with a comment naming each external consumer, then migrate at least the deep imports inside this batch to the barrel.
acceptance_criteria: content_browsing.dart contains one or more `export` statements for types already consumed outside the feature
flutter analyze stays clean after switching at least one external consumer (e.g. core/labels/curriculum_label_providers.dart) to the barrel import
